groups.title: body 月
groups.note: The 月 here is flesh, not moon: parts and stuff of the body.

chars.story: The joint of flesh in the middle of the leg: the knee.
The curved part of the flesh where hand meets arm.
chars.note: 大腕 'bigshot' is slang for a famous performer.

chars.story: Flesh with too much fat on it: greasy and cloying.
chars.note: 膩 became 腻: the right side was simplified.

chars.story: The soft fat that lies in the flesh.
Rich flesh piled high and rendered down: a thick paste.
Flesh gone grimy with dirt.
chars.note: Only in 肮脏 'dirty'. 骯 became 肮: 骨 became 月.

groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand on the left: scratching, tying, throwing.

chars.story: A hand clawing at an itch.
chars.note: 撓 became 挠: 堯 became 尧.

chars.story: A hand steers you off to the other side at a bend.
chars.note: Also 'to kidnap': 拐卖.

chars.story: A hand sends a thing flying through the air.
chars.note: 擲 became 掷: 鄭 became 郑. The written 'throw': 投掷; 抛 is the everyday toss.

chars.story: A hand drives down again and again: pound, mash, make trouble.
chars.note: 搗 became 捣: 島 became 岛.

chars.story: A hand binds things up tight so they cannot move: tie together.
chars.note: A bundle counter too: 一捆柴.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: liquids and what they do.

chars.story: Water spinning round and round into a hole.
chars.note: 渦 became 涡: the right side was simplified.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 刃 blade + 止 stop
chars.story: A liquid that catches on the tongue like a blade and stops there.
chars.note: 澀 became 涩: the right side was simplified.

chars.story: Liquid seeping slowly out of the body.
Water gathered in a deep hollow: a still pool.
Standing at the edge of the water: right on the brink.
chars.note: 瀕 became 濒: the right side was simplified.

chars.story: Water sinking away: the spirit drains out of you.
chars.note: Only in 沮丧 'dejected'.

chars.story: A river name, borrowed to write 'ice cream'.
chars.note: A river in Henan; today seen in 冰淇淋 (ice cream).

chars.story: A bamboo frame shaken to let the fine part through.
chars.note: 篩 became 筛: 師 became 师.

chars.story: Little stones: grit and sand.
What stays behind when the liquid has been strained.

groups.title: plants 艹 growing
groups.note: Grass on top: shoots, stems and creepers.

chars.story: The bright new shoot pushing out of the soil.
chars.note: 卖萌 'act cute' is internet slang; 萌 can mean 'cute' in slang.

chars.story: A green tooth poking up out of the ground.
The straight pillar a plant holds itself up on: a stalk.
chars.note: 莖 became 茎: the right side was simplified.

chars.story: Plants growing thick and green: lush.
A creeping stem spreading along the ground: a trailing stem.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 纟 silk + 昷 (sound)
chars.story: Fibres and threads packed away in a bundle: hold in store.
chars.note: 蘊 became 蕴: 糸 became 纟.

chars.story: A creeping plant with small, soft fruit: a berry.
A plant that stores its food underground: a potato or yam.
A pungent root, written with the shape of an old clan name.
chars.note: Also a surname (Jiang). 薑 became 姜.

groups.title: tree 木
groups.note: A tree on the left: wood and what it makes.

chars.story: An old tree with no sap left.
The little wooden piece that darts back and forth through the threads.
The first half of the word for the olive.
chars.note: Never alone: only in 橄榄. See 榄.

chars.story: A gate that drops to hold back the water.
chars.note: 閘 became 闸: 門 became 门.

chars.story: The wooden beam across the bottom of a doorway: a door sill.
chars.note: 檻 became 槛.

groups.title: voices
groups.note: A mouth on the left: calling out.

chars.story: A mouth opened as wide as a hole: a roar.
Talking round and round to bring someone along: coax.
chars.note: 哄 also means a roar of laughter or uproar (hong1), as in 哄堂大笑.

chars.story: A mouth reciting verse low and steady.
Pieces of jade, small and finely made: dainty.
chars.note: Also in girls' names.

chars.story: A mountain looming over you: how could that be?
chars.note: Literary: 岂非 'isn't it that'. 豈 became 岂.

chars.story: A mouth adding a light closing touch: a sentence-ending particle.
chars.note: As a particle, like 啦: 好咯 'all right then'.

groups.title: metal 钅
groups.note: Metal on the left: tools and coin.

chars.story: Metal made thin as paper: a banknote.
chars.note: 鈔 became 钞: 金 became 钅.

chars.story: A small metal knob you press: a push button.
chars.note: 鈕 became 钮.

chars.story: A hanging weight of metal on a handle: a hammer.
chars.note: 錘 became 锤.

chars.story: The soft heavy metal in pipes and bullets: lead metal.
chars.note: 鉛 became 铅.

chars.story: The light, silver metal of cans and foil.
chars.note: 鋁 became 铝.

chars.story: The sharp-smelling gas of cleaning fluid: ammonia.
A salty, stone-like substance: alkali.
chars.note: 鹼 became 碱.

groups.title: silk 纟
groups.note: Thread on the left: cord and weave.

chars.story: A thick cord strong enough to hold a ship: a cable.
chars.note: 纜 became 缆.

chars.story: Threads running across a loom, like the lines across a map.
chars.note: 緯 became 纬.

chars.parts: 纟 silk + 又 hand over 土 earth
chars.story: Thread drawn out strand after strand from the cocoon.
chars.note: 繹 became 绎.

groups.title: shell 贝
groups.note: Cowrie shells were money: payment and goods.

chars.story: Shell money paid for the use of something: lease.
chars.note: 賃 became 赁.

chars.story: Money handed over to buy someone back: redeem.
chars.note: 贖 became 赎.

chars.story: Money pressed on someone to get your way.
chars.note: 賂 became 赂.

chars.parts: - a crowded top over 贝 shell
chars.story: A shell-topped tangle of strokes: the short name for Jiangxi.
chars.note: Short name for Jiangxi province. 贛 became 赣.

chars.story: Soup on the fire: scalding hot.
chars.note: 燙 became 烫: 湯 became 汤.

chars.story: Food laid on a pan in front of a flame: fried.
A horse, only humbler and more stubborn: the donkey.
chars.note: 驢 became 驴: 馬 became 马.

chars.story: A horse with a lump on its back: the camel.
chars.note: 駝 became 驼.

chars.story: The tall white bird that stands on one leg: the crane.
chars.note: 鶴 became 鹤: 鳥 became 鸟.

chars.story: A fish-shaped beast with a huge mouth: the crocodile.
chars.note: 鱷 became 鳄.

chars.story: Claws curve down from a paw.
chars.note: Also 'zhuǎ' in speech: 爪子.

chars.story: A creature you have to take apart to eat: the crab.
The creature that hops about the wet ground: a frog.
The first half of the word for the web-maker.
chars.note: Never alone: only in 蜘蛛. See 蛛.

chars.story: Autumn in the heart: gloomy and anxious.
A person curled up with no strength left.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'weary'; same sense in modern use.

chars.story: A heart that puts itself in another's place: forgiving.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'reciprocity' (in 忠恕); on its own now it means 'forgive'.

chars.story: Watching another's door open while your own face sours.
chars.note: 妒 is also written 妬.

chars.story: Eyeing the next person's sheep with longing.
chars.note: 羨 became 羡.

chars.story: The woman married to your father's younger brother.
chars.note: 嬸 became 婶: 審 became 审.

chars.story: The person who comes after you in the family line.
chars.note: 姪 became 侄.

chars.story: An old fellow: a man, a guy.
chars.note: Cantonese flavour: 大佬 'boss', 鬼佬 'foreigner'.

chars.story: A young woman or girl.
chars.note: Casual, northern word.

chars.story: A big white boat from far away: an ocean vessel.
Cloth spread on the mast.
chars.note: 颿 is an old variant.

chars.story: Clothing that wraps all the way round: a robe.
A warm covering of fur or wool.

chars.parts: - a lidded pot with a round belly
chars.story: A pot with a lid on top and a belly below: a kettle.
chars.note: 壺 became 壶.

chars.story: A jar of mash bubbling as it works.
The one who pours the wine at the head of the tribe: tribal chief.
chars.note: In 阿联酋 (UAE) it is a transliteration.

chars.story: The first half of the word for a great storm.
chars.note: Only in 飓风. 颶 became 飓.

chars.story: Rain that freezes where it lands: frost.
Under the roof once the light is gone: night.
chars.note: 元宵 means both the festival and the rice dumplings.

chars.story: A peak with fresh, sharp edges: brand new.
chars.note: Almost always 崭新 'brand new'. 嶄 became 崭.

chars.story: Stone set tight into a rock wall.

groups.title: literary words
groups.note: Rare words that still show up in print.

chars.story: Looking north for something wonderful: you hope for it.
chars.note: Also the short name for Hebei province. The literary word for 盼.

chars.story: Words that explain the whole meaning of a text.
chars.note: 詮 became 诠.

chars.story: A rabbit running off: it escapes, or lives free of care.
The head star of the dipper: first in rank, and stalwart.
A smile that spreads softly like grass bending in the wind.
chars.note: Mostly 莞尔 and the city 东莞.

groups.title: single shapes
groups.note: Characters on their own, no neat family.

chars.parts: - a drawn bow with its string
chars.story: A curved bow with the string pulled tight: a bow weapon.

chars.parts: - a pot with two handles and three legs
chars.story: The great bronze cooking pot on its three legs.

chars.parts: - a sprout bent over in the soil
chars.story: A sprout bent low as soldiers camp on the land.
chars.note: A village or army camp; 三里屯 is a Beijing district.

chars.parts: 圭 jade tablet + 卜 divining
chars.story: A tablet cast and read: a divination sign.
chars.note: 八卦 is also the eight trigrams, and now 'gossip'.

chars.parts: - 立 stand over a short stroke
chars.story: Something stood up straight on end: erect.
chars.note: 豎 became 竖.

chars.story: A flick of the wrist and it is thrown away.
Seized by a strong tiger of a man: prisoner of war.
chars.note: 虜 became 虏.

chars.story: A sickness-like discomfort crawling under the skin.
chars.note: 癢 became 痒.

chars.story: An eye pressed to a hole in the wall.
chars.note: 窺 became 窥.

sentences.en: Ow, the coffee is very hot!
We had a heart-to-heart talk with each other.
I want to eat ice cream.
The trees are beginning to bud.
I was tired of watching TV.
